repositories.name: India Code: Digital Repository of All Central and State Acts
repositories.authority: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
repositories.scope: All Central Acts in force, State Acts, and historical consolidated legislation
repositories.licence_or_terms: Government of India Open Data License (GODL-India) / Copyright Act s.52(1)(q)
repositories.known_limitations: Consolidated acts may experience lag of 1-3 months following major amendments; PDF layout varies.

repositories.name: e-Gazette of India (The Gazette of India)
repositories.authority: Directorate of Printing, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
repositories.scope: Official Extraordinary and Ordinary Gazettes: Enactment Assents, Notifications, Rules, and Commencement S.O. Orders
repositories.licence_or_terms: Government of India Official Publication / Public Notice
repositories.known_limitations: Search index relies on publication date and issue number; scanned PDFs require robust OCR.

repositories.name: Supreme Court of India Official Judgments & Orders
repositories.scope: All reportable and non-reportable judgments, orders, and Constitution Bench decisions
repositories.known_limitations: Historical judgments pre-1990 have varied optical scan clarity; neutral citations (e.g. 2024 INSC ...) introduced systematically only from 2023.

repositories.name: Supreme Court Rules & Registry Practice Manuals
repositories.scope: Supreme Court Rules 2013, Practice Directions, Circulars, and Office Procedure Handbooks
repositories.licence_or_terms: Public Domain / Supreme Court Official Publication
repositories.known_limitations: Large monolithic PDF handbooks (200-300+ pages) exceed default single-pass chunking limits.

repositories.name: MeitY Cyber Laws, Data Protection & IT Rules Repository
repositories.authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
repositories.scope: IT Act 2000, IT Rules 2021, Intermediary Guidelines, DPDP Act rules and notifications
repositories.licence_or_terms: Government of India Open Data License (GODL-India)
repositories.known_limitations: Rules and amendment draft notifications are frequently posted in press releases before final gazetting.

repositories.name: MCA Companies Act, Rules & Circulars Repository
repositories.authority: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
repositories.scope: Companies Act 2013, Companies Rules, General Circulars, Decriminalization Notifications, LLP Act
repositories.licence_or_terms: Government of India Open Data License (GODL-India)
repositories.known_limitations: MCA portal enforces strict bot mitigation; automated scraping requires controlled pacing and user-agent headers.

repositories.name: MHA Criminal Law Reforms & Notification Portal
repositories.authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
repositories.scope: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), BNSS, BSA commencement notifications, SOPs, and police guidelines
repositories.licence_or_terms: Government of India Open Data License (GODL-India)
repositories.known_limitations: Commencement S.O. notifications are published across gazettes and MHA releases.

repositories.name: Law Commission of India Official Reports
repositories.authority: Law Commission of India, Ministry of Law and Justice
repositories.scope: Reports 1 through 289 detailing legislative intent, historical background of enactments, and proposed legal reforms
repositories.licence_or_terms: Government of India Open Data License (GODL-India)
repositories.known_limitations: Advisory documents; recommendations do not constitute operative law until enacted by Parliament.

repositories.name: National Green Tribunal Judgments & Orders Portal
repositories.authority: National Green Tribunal (Principal Bench, New Delhi)
repositories.scope: Environmental orders, EIA reviews, pollution directions, and statutory compliance orders
repositories.known_limitations: Zonal benches (Western, Eastern, Southern, Central) maintain separate daily cause lists.

repositories.name: Delhi High Court Judgments & Orders Repository
repositories.scope: Reportable and signed judgments and orders of the High Court of Delhi
repositories.known_limitations: State-level jurisdiction (IN-DL); binding within NCT of Delhi, persuasive for other High Courts.
